Five comments

Tjønneblomen

Composed by Norwegian hardingfele player Gjermund Haugen.
Transcribed from Laurie Hart & Paul Marchand “Cobbler’s Dream”.

↳ Posted by cumar on June 10th, 2017.

Re: Tjønneblomen

I think there may be some bars missing in the third part of this transcription. If you check it against Anneborg Lien’s playing on https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5F5aXGySVgg it sounds as though the first four bars of that section should be repeated after bar 8, so making the whole part 16 bars long instead of the 12 as written. Sounds logical, too. There’s also a very nice setting of this tune by The Danish String Quartet on ‘Last Leaf’ (ECM Records, 2017).

It has nothing to do with the Irish tradition, but is perhaps a justification for a reasonably relaxed approach to acceptable submissions to this site.

↳ Posted by Bazza on January 24th, 2020.

Re: Tjønneblomen

I LOVE this tune, and have played it for over 20 years now. Annbjørg Lien recorded it in A/F#m on her first album, ‘Fiddle Fever’, but in her live shows and live album her hardingfele is clearly tuned to BEBF# as she plays it in E/C#m! Love this tune…

↳ Posted by Erik-Fiddler on December 25th, 2023.

Re: Tjønneblomen

Yeah, the part that’s just missing in the original transcription is the C-part, as this tune runs AABBCCDDEE I believe. The C-part here should likely be repeated…or something like that. Lol. This is how I play it, roughly. I think it’s the inclusion of the “ef” in the first bar of the C part that threw it off. Those sounded like pickup notes to me, and likely come from the preceding bar of the B-part.

|ef|:g2 b2 a2|f2 gf ef|g2 bb (f2|f3) f2 ef|g2 b2 a2|f3 gf|e2 e2 d2|B3 B ef|
g2 b2 a2|f2 gf ef|g2 bb (f2|f3) f2 ef|g2 b2 a2|f4 d|e6|e6||

↳ Posted by Erik-Fiddler on December 25th, 2023.

Tjønneblomen, X:3

In E, it’s best played in BEBF# tuning, if you dare. Or leave that to the hardangers. I’ve done it on a 3/4 size fiddle with full size strings. And I’ve done it on a 4/4 instrument. Not one I cared about. Lol.

↳ Posted by Erik-Fiddler on December 25th, 2023.
